changelog:
v2.9.0 — Premium Home Redesign + Watch History

• New Episodes row — detects unwatched episodes for tracked series
• Watch It Again row — completed content for easy rewatching
• Enhanced Continue Watching cards — episode badges + time remaining
• Clear Watch History option in Settings
• Premium card redesign — bigger 180×270dp poster cards with 14dp corners
• Focus-revealed metadata line + micro-CTA on poster cards
• Shimmer loading on poster and section cards
• Section cards redesigned — 320×160dp with glass border
• Neighbor dimming — spotlight effect dims non-focused cards in each row
• Row header highlighting — labels turn gold when row is focused
• Track picker fix — audio tracks now refresh after channel/episode switch
• New app icon and TV banner
